title: Meet the research team

members.name: Dominik Siemon
members.description: Dominik Siemon is an Associate Professor at LUT University. His research focuses on the design of information systems, human–computer interaction, and artificial intelligence, with particular interest in how technology affects people and organizations.

members.name: Ram Gurung
members.description: Ram Gurung is a Junior Researcher in Software Engineering at LUT University. His published research includes green coding, software energy efficiency, and AI-assisted software testing.

members.name: Ashkan Kohandel Shirazi
members.description: Ashkan Kohandel Shirazi is a Junior Research Assistant at LUT University, working on the Digital Sustainability Companion project.

introduction: The team at LUT University is developing the Digital Sustainability Companion and preparing its research evaluation.
